snippet.title: Moonlit Journey:  Homestead
snippet.description:
🌙 Moonlit Journey: Homestead Demo

Build your dream homestead, uncover ancient mysteries, and explore a world where every season brings new adventures.

Moonlit Journey: Homestead is a cozy pixel-art RPG that blends farming, fishing, mining, crafting, exploration, and story-driven quests into a relaxing adventure filled with secrets waiting to be discovered.

🌾 Features

• Farm and grow crops through all four seasons
• Fish in rivers and lakes for unique species
• Mine for valuable ores and rare gems
• Craft tools, equipment, and useful items
• Complete quests and level up your skills
• Discover hidden dungeons and secret puzzles
• Explore a handcrafted world full of mysteries

🎮 Play the Free Demo on Steam

Wishlist the full game and try the demo today!
